results.name: Supply chain lead times across three preps
results.question: In my Otis supply chain delay story, how much did material lead times increase, and how did I keep projects on schedule?
results.answer: The material lead times increased from 12 to 16 weeks [1][2][3]. The owner kept projects on schedule by taking a two-pronged approach: first, working with the factory to implement partial shipments so mechanics could start assembly immediately with available parts [1][2][3]. Second, the owner coordinated with field mechanics to put in significant overtime to make up for remaining schedule gaps [1][2][3].
